Cat people will love this personalised cat word art print: a grey tabby cat, filled with the name and quirks of their favourite feline. It's a lovely gift for a new kitten, a cat's birthday or a cat-mad friend.

Your personalised cat word art print, made with your words

Fill in two boxes: the cat's name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as nicknames, favourite sleeping spots, treats and naughty habits. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the design, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Tips: use single words or phrases of no more than three words, put commas between them and check your spelling. No icons, emoji or accented letters, please. We print exactly what you type.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand
  • One of a kind: every word comes from you, so no two prints are the same

Size & details

  • Design: a grey tabby cat, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised cat word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.

A brilliant personalised cat gift for birthdays, Christmas or a new kitten.
